desc:
🚨 RED ALERT UPDATE!

🏍️ GO FASTER OR GET EATEN!

One driver, one shooter… and monsters right on your tail. Race through the forest at night as the driver dodges obstacles and the passenger blasts the creatures chasing you! 🔫

SOLO or DUO !

💀 Stall out? They’ll catch you.
🌲 Watch the trail… and your back.
🤝 Pick your teammate wisely. You’re counting on each other.

Hit the gas. Make your shots count. And whatever you do… DON’T BRAKE.
